dedupe_keys.name: rasterdaten der beobachteten und projizierten hitzeperioden von mindestens 3 tagen fur niedersachsen ar5 ni version 2 1

description: Rasterdaten der beobachteten und projizierten Hitzeperioden von mindestens 3 Tagen für Niedersachsen (AR5-NI Version 2.1) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten-niedersach-sen.de. The zip folder contains 30-year grid averages for observation (1961-1990 to 1991-2020) and the result range with mean absolute values and change signals for 1971-2000 for projection periods of the climate scenarios RCP8.5 and RCP2.6 (2031-2060 and 2071-2100) in the coordinate system epsg:4647 (UTM32) for the time units: - yr: Calendar year (Jan. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Grid data of observed and projected heat periods of at least 3 days for Lower Saxony (AR5-NI version 2.1)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, ENVI. The listing shows 2024-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
